title: End card on film
description: The last screen as a film frame: a result clip or picture fills the frame behind a dark veil, the closing line comes in word by word, then one to three link buttons (real links, they work on the slide too) and the brand line. For results and graphics; do not use footage of a person here, the veil covers the whole picture.

props.title: required, 2-7 words
props.src: clip (mp4/webm) or picture behind the words: a result, not a person
props.links: 1-3 items: {label, href}; the first one is the filled button
props.poster: still shown before the video loads
